messages:
jen: P1 — EU Hosted inference 502 spike. Seeing ~12% error rate for text-gen endpoints. I'm reverting the recent routing change that moved traffic to model-quant-v2. Incident page: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/1976001234

opsbot: Incident created: INC-1976001234 | severity: P1 | pages sent to #oncall-eng

mike_sre: I'm taking on-call. Collecting request traces and route logs. Early signal: mux forwarded to quant-v2 which returns 502s under long-contexts.

alice_platform: Observability: error_rate(hosted::eu) from 0.4% -> 12.1% at 11:03 UTC. KV cache misses also spiked. Link: https://grafana.redwood.ai/d/XYZ

carlos_eng: Rolling back route change now:
```bash
kubectl apply -f /deploys/routing/rollback-1976001234.yaml --namespace=hosted-routing
# rollout status
kubectl rollout status deploy/routing-proxy -n hosted-routing
```

opsbot: Action log: rollback manifest applied by carlos_eng at 11:06 UTC

sarah_prod: CS notif: pinged customers in EU in the affected segment, opened support threads for top 5 customers.

emma_cs: Two customers reported degraded responses; they've confirmed reduced errors after ~11:10 UTC.

incident_bot: Current status: Mitigated — error rate reduced to ~1.2% cluster-wide but some tail nodes still at ~3%. Ongoing verification.

mike_sre: Confirming request traces show successful routing to quant-v1. Will run targeted restarts for 3 nodes with elevated errors.

alice_platform: Running targeted restart: `kubectl rollout restart sts/worker-eu-3` — monitoring CPU/IO.

mike_sre: Targeted restarts completed; tail error nodes back to baseline. Rolling to monitoring window of 30m.

jen: Thanks all. Postmortem owner: mike_sre. Postmortem scheduled iCal invite for 2026-03-24 13:00 UTC. If anyone has customer context, DM mike_sre.

carlos_eng: Follow-ups: add integration test for routing policy validation, add canary for config pushes to routing-proxy.

jen: Closing update — fully mitigated at 11:22 UTC. We'll keep the incident open during verification window.

:thumbsup:
